entries.displayNameTr: Fırınlanmış Tavuk Üst But Eti (Çözelti İlave Edilmiş)
entries.stateRationale: Source explicitly reports thigh, roasted, with added solution.

entries.sourceDescription: Turkey, retail parts, breast, meat only, with added solution, cooked, roasted
entries.displayNameTr: Fırınlanmış Hindi Göğüs Eti (Çözelti İlave Edilmiş)
entries.stateRationale: Source explicitly reports breast and added solution, not marination.

entries.displayNameTr: Fırınlanmış Tavuk Baget Eti (Çözelti İlave Edilmiş)

entries.sourceDescription: Pork, fresh, loin, blade (roasts), boneless, separable lean only, cooked, roasted
entries.displayNameEn: Roasted Pork Blade Loin (Boneless, Lean Only)
entries.displayNameTr: Fırınlanmış Domuz Sırt Eti (Ön Bölüm, Kemiksiz, Yağsız Et)

entries.sourceDescription: Rice, white, long-grain, parboiled, enriched, cooked
entries.displayNameTr: Pişmiş Ön Haşlanmış Beyaz Pirinç (Uzun Taneli, Zenginleştirilmiş)
entries.stateRationale: Cooked is explicit; parboiled does not prove the final cooking method is boiled.

entries.sourceDescription: Rice, white, long-grain, parboiled, unenriched, cooked
entries.displayNameTr: Pişmiş Ön Haşlanmış Beyaz Pirinç (Uzun Taneli, Zenginleştirilmemiş)
entries.stateRationale: Cooked is explicit; retain enrichment distinction and reject method inference from parboiled.

entries.sourceDescription: Rice, brown, parboiled, dry, UNCLE BEN'S
entries.displayNameTr: Ön Haşlanmış Esmer Pirinç (Kuru, Uncle Ben's)
entries.stateRationale: Dry processed grain is not ready-cooked or raw. No existing enum describes this precisely; UNSPECIFIED makes no heat/edibility claim. Dry is mandatory in both display names.

entries.sourceDescription: Seeds, sunflower seed butter, without salt
entries.stateRationale: Spread is identified, but source does not report raw/roasted status. Preserve unknown instead of claiming raw or inferring a mixed recipe.

entries.sourceDescription: Nuts, cashew butter, plain, without salt added
entries.stateRationale: Source does not report heat treatment. No added salt is not a claim of zero sodium.

entries.sourceDescription: Seeds, sunflower seed kernels, toasted, without salt
entries.stateRationale: Reviewed dry-heat toasted seed maps to the existing ROASTED family; exact toasted method stays in the label and source evidence.

entries.sourceDescription: Seeds, sesame seed kernels, toasted, without salt added (decorticated)
entries.displayNameEn: Toasted Hulled Sesame Seeds (No Added Salt)
entries.stateRationale: Reviewed toasted seed maps to ROASTED; hulled/decorticated and no-added-salt distinctions remain explicit.

entries.sourceDescription: Squash, winter, acorn, cooked, boiled, mashed, without salt
entries.stateRationale: Acorn squash is not corn; retain mashed edible form and explicit boiled method.

entries.sourceDescription: Squash, winter, spaghetti, cooked, boiled, drained, or baked, without salt
entries.stateRationale: COOKED is the source-proven common family for boiled OR baked. Do not claim roasted or fabricate two separate nutrition profiles.
